definition: to keep going even though it is hard
description: On a high mountain pass in a snowstorm, a man in a black cycling helmet and black kit rides a racing bike up a snow-covered road towards the front, his face set and his breath steaming, snowflakes stuck to his clothes. He keeps pedalling hard and comes closer. Behind him a group of cyclists wrapped in silver foil blankets stand outside a small stone hut and watch, and a marmot sits on a rock by the road. Dark clouds and rays of light cover the snowy peaks behind.

en.question: What is the man in black doing?

de.answer: Er kämpft sich durch den Schnee.
de.question: Was macht der Mann in Schwarz?

es.answer: Está avanzando con esfuerzo a través de la nieve.
